title: 第132章 收妖计划第131章 训蛇
content_zh:
第一卷第132章收妖计划
“撑住身体折磨易，抵挡心头煎熬难，弟子想做的，也不过是反复碾压她的道心，让她长期处于煎熬之中，直到道心彻底崩碎成渣，将先前她所认同的理念尽数推翻，重新注入新的理念，将禅道对她的利用无限放大，灌输禅道只想控制她、我们是在拯救她的理念，从头至尾洗涤一遍她的灵魂……”
听着陈玄侃侃而谈，在场众人皆神情怪异，升起一股寒意。
凌璇玑黑着脸揉了揉眉心，一时竟不知让陈玄做这件事是对是错。
倒是陈椽锡没什么反应，思考着陈玄所述方案的可行性。
片刻后，他问道：“想法倒是不错，可问题是如何才能将她道心摧毁？她千年前就跟着莲台仙宗宗主修行，又是化神巅峰修为，道心早已坚如磐石，怕是没那么容易动摇。”
“天道意识之下，生灵皆有七情六欲，有私欲就说明道心有隙。”陈玄淡定一笑，“正如弟子方才所言，她虽得了禅道造化，但因她身怀凶妖血脉，始终只是禅道的一句傀儡，难以走上明面，至今连个记名弟子的名号都没混上，弟子不相信，她一个本妖族生灵，会心甘情愿没有一丝怨念。”
陈椽锡突然一笑，突然有种惺惺相惜之感。
他问道：“你的意思是，放大她心中的怨念，摧毁心智？”
陈玄点头，笑着作揖，“正是。”
陈椽锡问道：“你想怎么做？”
陈玄道：“此事还需诸位配合，在此地打造一个连环阵法……”
陈椽锡有些不明所以，但想到陈玄此番‘高论’，却也没再多说什么，安排众人开始忙活起来。
于是，十方岛偏北的一处空地上，陈玄做监工，指挥十方岛陈椽锡门下炼气士，开始布置连环大阵。
凌璇玑摇头轻叹，看向涟绥道人的目光中带着些怜悯。
却也并未阻止，毕竟一个化神境的凶妖，若不能收归己用，在后续师弟针对禅道的计划中，是个不小的变数，对人间道承的威胁也太大了些。
……
飞仙门山门向东数百里的灵宝镇主街上。
一家丹药铺子门口。
一名身穿大褂的青年坐在门槛上，看着萧索的街道长吁短叹。

飞仙门遭劫时，灵宝镇也被波及，灵宝镇的常住民死的死、跑的跑，就连镇子上最大、背景最深厚的白玉楼，也在一夜之间消失，整幢玉楼被连根拔起。
白玉楼原先的位置，空出了一大片。
如今过去大半个月，镇上总算又有了些行人，但都是跑来碰运气，看能不能找上个好点的地皮，也开个店铺。
这半月以来，福临丹阁的生意一天比一天凄惨。
陈昶视线落在远处，先前白玉楼所在的空地。
那里已经重新动土开始施工，由一壮一瘦两人监造，也不知要盖个什么建筑。
这两人陈昶有些印象。
早先成日在镇上厮混，干些坑蒙拐骗的事。
前阵子不见了踪迹，原以为是被人打死丢了，不曾想这又回来了。
好像还攀上了某个大人物，看穿着可是比以前好了不知多少倍。
施工现场贴着飞仙门的告示，想来这两人背后的，应该是飞仙门某个前辈高人吧。
陈昶百无聊赖，思绪有些难以安定。
‘也不知道师父和师姐、师弟怎样了，有没有出事。’
他越想越坐不住，干脆起身回了院子，收拾好行囊关了店门，朝灵宝镇外走去。
陈昶足足花费一天时间，将法力灌注在双腿，直到日薄西山，才到了飞仙门山门处。
看守山门的是个穿红袍的陌生执事。
陈昶猜测，应该是前不久的劫难，让飞仙门加强了戒备，将值守的弟子换成了执事。
‘也不知现在还能不能进去……’
他这般想着，鼓足勇气上前。
第一卷第132章收妖计划

那执事远远的就注意到陈昶，见他还在靠近，呵斥道：“来者止步，山门已戒严，禁制任何人进出！”
陈昶停下脚步。
他知道想进去多半是奢望了，便远远地喊道：“前辈，弟子陈昶，早先在太穹峰修行，来此就是想打听一下，我师父、师姐他们还好吗？”
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 132 Plan to Conquer Demons
"It is easy to hold on to the physical torture, but it is difficult to resist the mental torture. What the disciple wants to do is to repeatedly crush her Taoist heart and keep her in torment for a long time until the Taoist heart is completely shattered into slag. Overthrow all the ideas she previously agreed with and inject new ideas to infinitely magnify Zen Tao's use of her. Instill the idea that Zen Tao only wants to control her and we are saving her, and cleanse her soul from beginning to end..."
Listening to Chen Xuan's talk, everyone present looked strange and felt a chill.
Ling Xuanji rubbed her eyebrows with a dark face, not knowing whether it was right or wrong to let Chen Xuan do this.
Chen Rongxi, on the other hand, had no reaction and was thinking about the feasibility of Chen Xuan's plan.
After a moment, he asked: "The idea is good, but the question is how to destroy her Taoist heart? She practiced with the master of the Liantai Immortal Sect thousands of years ago, and she is at the peak of Shen Transformation. Her Taoist heart has long been as solid as a rock, and I am afraid it will not be shaken so easily."
"Under the consciousness of Heaven, all living beings have seven emotions and six desires. Having selfish desires shows that there is a gap in the heart of the Tao." Chen Xuan smiled calmly, "As the disciple said just now, although she has been blessed with the Zen Tao, because she has the blood of the evil demon, she has always been just a puppet of the Zen Tao, and it is difficult to rise to the surface. So far, she has not even been named as a registered disciple. The disciple does not believe that she, a creature of the demon clan, will be willing to have no resentment."
Chen Rongxi suddenly smiled and felt a sense of sympathy.
He asked: "You mean to amplify the resentment in her heart and destroy her mind?"
Chen Xuan nodded, smiled and bowed, "Exactly."
Chen Rongxi asked: "What do you want to do?"
Chen Xuandao: "This matter still requires your cooperation to create a chain formation here..."
Chen Rongxi was a little confused, but thinking of Chen Xuan's 'high talk', he didn't say anything more and arranged for everyone to get busy.
Therefore, in an open space in the north of Shifang Island, Chen Xuan acted as a supervisor and directed the Qi refiners under Chen Rongxi's sect on Shifang Island to start setting up a series of large formations.
Ling Xuanji shook her head and sighed, looking at Taoist Liansui with some pity in her eyes.
But he didn't stop it. After all, if a ferocious monster in the realm of gods cannot be used for his own purposes, it will be a big variable in the junior brother's subsequent plan for Zen, and the threat to the inheritance of the human world will be too great.
…
Feixianmen Mountain Gate is hundreds of miles east of the main street of Lingbao Town.
The entrance of a pill shop.
A young man in a coat sat on the threshold, looking at the desolate street and sighing.
When Feixianmen was robbed, Lingbao Town was also affected. The residents of Lingbao Town died and ran away. Even the White Jade Tower, the largest and most profound background in the town, disappeared overnight, and the entire Jade Tower was uprooted.
A large area of ​​​​the original location of Baiyu Tower was vacant.
Now that more than half a month has passed, there are finally some pedestrians in the town, but they are all here to try their luck and see if they can find a better land and open a shop.
In the past half month, Fulindan Pavilion's business has become increasingly miserable day by day.
Chen Chang's eyes fell on the open space in the distance where the White Jade Tower was previously.
Construction has started again there, with two people, one strong and one thin, supervising the construction. They don't know what kind of building they are going to build.
Chen Chang had some impressions of these two people.
In the early days, he hung out in the town all day long, doing some deception and abduction.
He disappeared a while ago. I thought he was beaten to death and lost, but I never thought he would come back again.
It seems that he has become acquainted with some important person, and his clothes look many times better than before.
There is a Feixianmen notice posted at the construction site. It seems that the person behind these two people must be a senior expert from Feixianmen.
Chen Chang was bored and had trouble settling his thoughts.
‘I don’t know what happened to my master, senior sister, and junior brother, or whether anything happened. ’
The more he thought about it, the more he couldn't sit still, so he simply got up and went back to the yard, packed his bags, closed the store, and walked out of Lingbao Town.
Chen Chang spent a lot of moneyFor a day, I poured my magic power into my legs, and it wasn't until the sun set that I reached the gate of Feixianmen.
The person guarding the mountain gate is a strange deacon in red robe.
Chen Chang guessed that it was the recent disaster that caused the Feixian Sect to increase its vigilance and replace the disciples on duty with deacons.
'I don't know if I can still go in now...'
With this thought in mind, he mustered up the courage to step forward.

The deacon noticed Chen Chang from a distance, saw that he was still approaching, and yelled: "Stop anyone who comes, the mountain gate is under security and no one is allowed to enter or exit!"
Chen Chang stopped.
He knew that entering was probably a luxury, so he shouted from a distance: "Senior, disciple Chen Chang, who practiced at Taiqiong Peak earlier, came here just to find out how my master and senior sister are doing?"
